summary: Diff adds frontend scripts and docs for clean rebuild, live-only deploy flow, and post-deploy verification against https://areaworkars.caffeine.ai. However, the live deployment itself is only described as a placeholder and there is no concrete implementation shown that would actually publish to the live domain or address NXDOMAIN at the DNS/platform level. Several unrelated changes (notably backend category data and large frontend feature summaries) appear outside the scope of the redeploy/build/deploy verification request.

missing_requirements.requirement: Deploy the clean production build directly to the live environment so the live domain https://areaworkars.caffeine.ai is created and serves the app; do not create or publish any draft/preview deployment as part of this redeploy.
missing_requirements.reason: The added deploy script explicitly states the deployment command is a placeholder and that the actual deployment is expected to be performed by Caffeine’s build system; no concrete deploy command/config is shown that would actually publish to live or ensure no draft/preview is created.

missing_requirements.requirement: DNS for areaworkars.caffeine.ai resolves (no NXDOMAIN) and https://areaworkars.caffeine.ai loads the application in a browser after deployment.
missing_requirements.reason: No changes in the diff demonstrate DNS or platform configuration updates; verification checks HTTP/HTML after deployment but does not implement or fix DNS resolution (NXDOMAIN).

missing_requirements.requirement: Perform a forced clean production rebuild of the current codebase (clear frontend caches/build artifacts) and ensure the production build completes successfully (no build errors).
missing_requirements.reason: A clean-build script is added to clear caches/artifacts and run a build, but the diff cannot prove that the production build actually completes successfully in CI/CD (no build logs or pipeline/config changes shown).

hallucinated_features.description: Backend data/model change expanding/altering normalizedCategories and related category/subcategory lists.
hallucinated_features.reason: BuildRequest is focused on clean rebuild, live deploy, and verification; it explicitly discourages new product features or backend changes unless strictly required for build/deploy, and the diff does not show this is necessary for deployment.

hallucinated_features.description: Large changes/updates to frontend feature summary metadata describing routes, pages, UI design system, bilingual components, etc.
hallucinated_features.reason: Not requested by the redeploy/build/deploy verification requirements and appears unrelated to fixing NXDOMAIN or performing a clean production rebuild/deploy.
